purpose: Record two independently discovered UI/counting duplication failures and the general representation law extracted from them.

cases.observed_failure: The 312-day Palomar ledger nested 640 in-window plate-center RA/Dec rows. The generic coordinate scanner rendered those as new JANUS sky targets while the canonical POSS-I manifest already rendered the same plate centers.
cases.bad_effect: One astronomical survey entity appeared through two representations, making the SPACE lane look structurally strange and inflating rendered point counts.
cases.repair: Render POSS-I plate centers once; use observation-day rows only to enrich those plate entities with date, candidate, exposure and detector metadata.

cases.observed_failure: Bridge preregistration/result JSON can repeat site/date information already represented by canonical Earth event ledgers. The generic scanner therefore risks turning methodological metadata into additional Earth events and counting the same frozen date more than once.
cases.bad_effect: Presentation match-state counts can be inflated and become unsafe as an inferential cohort.
cases.repair: Treat domains/bridge as relation/test metadata only; do not render it as a second Earth or sky entity layer. Treat the site-coordinate registry as coordinate authority only, not as an event source.

general_laws: METADATA ABOUT AN ENTITY != NEW ENTITY
DIFFERENT REPRESENTATIONS OF THE SAME DECISION-RELEVANT OBJECT -> ONE CANONICAL RENDERED ENTITY
A CONTROL OR PREREGISTRATION MAY DESCRIBE AN EVENT WITHOUT BECOMING ANOTHER EVENT

relation_to_janus_representation_contrac.connection: The Observer exposed the same general failure class already seen in JANUS quotient computation: naming/history/metadata multiplicity can create artificial state multiplicity unless representation identity is contracted before comparison.

epistemic_boundary: Quotienting removes representation duplicates; it must never merge genuinely independent witnesses merely because they are similar. Identity must be supported by the representation contract, not visual resemblance.
canonical_seal: THE MAP MUST NOT CREATE NEW EVENTS BY READING ABOUT THE SAME EVENT TWICE. CONTRACT IDENTITY FIRST; THEN RENDER AND COUNT.
